title: SynEval: Synthetic Data Evaluation Framework
summary: SynEval is a command-line framework that scores LLM-generated synthetic data across fidelity, utility, diversity, and privacy dimensions relative to an original dataset. Its bundled generator sub-project, SynGen, declares sdv (>=1.0.0) as a dependency specifically to produce synthetic data via CTGAN, though the harvested evidence shows only dependency installation, not a source call site.
needs: No source line in the repository actually imports/calls sdv or CTGAN classes; only requirements/pyproject declarations and pip-install logs are captured, so real usage cannot be confirmed.
